description: Internal alterations including reinstating original ceiling heights in entrance hallway, living room and kitchen; reinstating two Victorian fireplaces to the living room and master bedroom; reinstating original door openings to the entrance hallway and raising the door heights to match the existing living room door opening; reinstating a singular upper window (2nd floor) to the front living room balcony doors; replacement of two non-timber casement bathroom windows (rear and side return elevations) serving existing bathrooms with traditional timber sash units to fit within existing openings; upgrading the existing glazing to slim line, conservation double glazing; installation of upgraded and fully internally installed air conditioning equipment, and adjustments and improvements throughout.
